bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lich_missi: Replace the projectile with a Lich missile, slowing its victim.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_petal_blad: Replace the projectile with a sharp void petal.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lich_comet: Replace the projectile with a comet that explodes on impact.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_spore_ball: Replace the projectile with a spore ball that erupts after landing.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_comet_burs: Release a comet explosion at the resolved location.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_spore_burs: Release spores that erupt after a delay at the resolved location.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_spore_bur: Increase spore damage by the configured Harm amplification.
Decrease spore damage by the configured Harm amplification.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_obsidian_b: Warn the ground around the resolved location, then erupt and launch creatures upward.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_obsidian_: Increase damage per hit using the Harm glyph amplification value.
Decrease damage per hit using the Harm glyph amplification value.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fire_wave: Send a sequence of ground eruptions along the trigger direction, launching and igniting creatures.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_fire_wave: Increase damage per hit using the Harm glyph amplification value.
Decrease damage per hit using the Harm glyph amplification value.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_obsidian_s: Erupt near the target three times, dealing damage and slowing creatures. Entity targets are tracked between rounds.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_obsidian_: Increase damage per hit using the Harm glyph amplification value.
Decrease damage per hit using the Harm glyph amplification value.
bomd_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_earthdive: Move the selected creature through a nearby wall along the trigger direction. Self-casts use its facing. Unbreakable blocks stop passage.
